verdict.rationale: Oneleet's docs say controls are automatically added per framework and are kept when another framework still requires them. That implies a shared control set across frameworks, and the product supports SOC 2, ISO 27001 and HIPAA side by side. The evidence only implies cross-mapping through the framework-removal behavior; it never shows SOC 2 evidence counting toward ISO 27001 or HIPAA, or any view of the overlap. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of cross-framework control/evidence mapping, a UI showing framework overlap, automatic evidence reuse across frameworks, independent corroboration.
